note: Snapshot for human review, not a guarantee about the installed version. Experimental actions must be confirmed in Gopher.

capabilities.name: Orientação sobre FL Studio / FL Studio guidance
capabilities.description: Answers questions using FL Studio support documentation.
limitations: Answers may be incorrect; verify in the installed version.

capabilities.name: Inspeção do projeto / Project inspection
capabilities.description: May report channels, plugins and Mixer state after user approval.
limitations: Requires the user's permission inside FL Studio.
Availability depends on the installed version.

capabilities.name: Tempo do projeto / Project tempo
capabilities.description: May read or set the project BPM.
limitations: Confirm availability and the exact requested BPM before changing it.

capabilities.name: Channel Rack
capabilities.description: May manage channels and populate sequencer steps.
limitations: Specify one target and one operation per instruction.
Do not assume instruments or channels are already present.

capabilities.name: Mixer
capabilities.description: May adjust track controls, routing and effect slots.
limitations: Require an identified track and a precise operation.

capabilities.name: Parâmetros de plugins / Plugin parameters
capabilities.description: May adjust controls exposed by plugins to FL Studio.
limitations: Not every plugin exposes every parameter.

capabilities.name: Análise direta de áudio / Direct audio analysis
capabilities.description: No confirmation here that Gopher listens to audio or measures its musical properties.
capabilities.source: Review note: the reviewed control manual does not establish this capability.
limitations: Ask Gopher what it can inspect; treat user observations as reports, not measurements by this API.
